description: Create, review, and improve skills for Pi agents. A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md that teaches an agent specialized workflows, domain knowledge, or tool integrations. Use when asked to create a new skill, improve an existing skill, review a skill for quality, scaffold a skill from a workflow, or convert documentation into a skill. Also triggers on "make a skill for", "build a skill", "skill for [topic]", "teach the agent to", or "package this workflow as a skill".
